views.title: Big picture
views.summary: Customers use a website to sign in and file claims. The website talks to our claims service, which stores data in the company database, notifies other systems, and asks an AI service to flag possible fraud. A nightly job turns claims into a report.
views.technical_summary: React SPA -> FastAPI (auth + claims routers) -> SQL Server (app schema) + Kafka topic claims.submitted + OpenAI; nightly pandas job builds rpt.daily_claims and a CSV.

walkthrough.text: This is the whole Claims Portal on one page. Let's follow a customer from sign-in to a filed claim.
It starts with a customer opening the portal in their browser.
Everything they type, including their password and claim details, is sent to our Claims service. This is sensitive data.
The Claims service is the single front door. It checks who the customer is and applies the business rules. Double-click it to see inside.
Accounts are checked against, and new claims are saved to, the company database.
Each claim is also sent to an outside AI service for a fraud check. Note: claim data leaves the company here.
These are the outside services we depend on.
Every night, a job summarises the day's claims into a report for the operations team.
